https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/958

Note, this PR also adds a new triple to GET /container that gets the number of children by iterating through the child nodes. This increases the response time of a GET... however, it is not clear how else to provide this information.

Also, once this ticket has been closed, REST API documentation is needed for the Limit header.
A. Soroka? Unknown? Jared Whiklo? Esmé Cowles? anyone? can you please review this PR?
I'll give it a run this morning.

I ran this and it works as expected for display in the HTML UI, response to curl calls and respecting the Limit header , I know A. Soroka has some code review comments.

The other thing I noticed is we list the children twice in the HTML UI. Once under Children and then again in the Properties (ldp:contains). Just seems redundant.

That is an interesting observation, Jared Whiklo. The fact that the children of a resource are listed twice in the HTML view of a parent resource is an existing condition, unrelated to this ticket. However, if you have a clear recommendation for what you would like to see instead, please create a ticket describing that.
